name: Apple Inc.
why: Baseline large-cap 10-K filer, happy path. Also non-calendar fiscal year end (late September).

name: Microsoft Corp
why: Second baseline large-cap 10-K filer. Non-calendar fiscal year end (June 30).

name: JPMorgan Chase & Co
why: Baseline large-cap, calendar fiscal year end. Also stresses submissions pagination: verified live 2026-08-14 to have 69 continuation files (CIK0000019617-submissions-NNN.json) beyond the base submissions file.

name: Alphabet Inc.
why: One CIK, multiple simultaneous tickers (GOOGL/GOOG/GOOGM/GOOGN per doc 08's Day 2 finding) -- CIK-is-the-permanent-identity edge case.

name: Block, Inc.
why: Ticker changed (SQ -> XYZ, December 2021) -- ticker is a mutable nickname, not a stable identity.

name: Reddit, Inc.
why: Recently IPO'd (March 2024). Short/incomplete filing history; verified live 2026-08-14 to have no submissions continuation pages, unlike the older large filers in this set.

name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd
why: Foreign private issuer, 20-F filer. Verified live 2026-08-14: reports under the ifrs-full taxonomy, not us-gaap -- the Collector must store this as-is without assuming a us-gaap shape.

name: Enbridge Inc
why: Canadian MJDS filer, 40-F. Non-10-K/10-Q form-type handling.

name: Ares Capital Corp
why: Has a 10-K/A amendment on file (found via EDGAR full-text search, filed 2026-03-23) -- amendment handling.

name: Nike, Inc.
why: Second non-calendar fiscal year end example (May 31), independent of the AAPL/MSFT pair.
